# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen years old during the autumn term of his Fourth Book year, turning sixteen in the following volume.  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c19 P44](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0044), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)</sub>
- **Titles:** Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall youth with wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown (hazel) eyes, and a mocking grin. He has a magnificent, firm chin and a handsome, open face with broad shoulders as he matures.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Hugh is intelligent, competitive, teasing, and hardworking, possessing an open and direct demeanor. He likes to plague or joke with girls, yet he is polite, honorable, and quick to apologize when he realizes he has genuinely hurt someone's feelings. Driven by high ideals and ambition, he works diligently to fund his own education and strives to be worthy of his friends and community.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c19 P52](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0052)_

- To gain Nell Harcourt's friendship and affection  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c28 P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v2 c19 P52](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0052)</sub>

## History

Hugh returned to Brierley school in Fourth Book after spending the summer in New Brunswick and three prior years in Alberta. He immediately established a fierce academic rivalry with Nell Harcourt after pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots', which resulted in her breaking her slate over his head. Though he tried to apologize, Nell refused to forgive him, prompting a years-long rivalry where they competed for top marks. He participated actively in community and school events, reciting 'Bingen on the Rhine' at the Debating Club concert and co-founding the Brierley Village Improvement Society, serving as its president. He rescued Nell from a collapsing pier support on the Lake of Glassy Waters during a game of 'Elaine', but when he asked to be friends, she coldly rejected him, leading him to vow never to ask again. Despite their distance, they both advanced to Fifth Class and then Regent's Academy, where they competed for the Gold Medal and Avery Scholarship. Hugh won the Gold Medal and tied with Nell at the head of the entrance pass list, while Nell won the Avery. To earn money for medical college, Hugh took a teaching post at Pale Sands for a year. Learning that Nell wished to teach locally in Brierley, Hugh voluntarily withdrew his application for the Brierley school so the trustees would hire her instead. Following this selfless act, Nell thanked him and they reconciled, becoming close friends and study partners. Hugh eventually left for Wexcombe College alongside Nell after winning his medal and completing his teaching year.

## Background by volume

- Lived in Alberta for three years during his childhood while his father was ill, causing him to miss early schooling  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Visited New Brunswick cousins for a summer before returning to school in Fourth Book  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- Family lived on an ancient orchard property across the Lake of Glassy Waters  <sub>[v1 c17 P24](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0024)</sub>
